name: Shrinkwrapped Insanity
description: Crazy Shit, vacuum-sealed and shipped straight into your skull: breaks scrambled while the hats hop between your ears, bubble wrap popping all around your head, a cat opera with a tomcat circling you, a microwave choir whose robot rides a turntable around you, a polka split by partials under a circling air-raid siren, Chebyshev curves with a different filter in each ear, fractal melodies hopping on Thue-Morse, five tempos placed around the room, a hook hidden in noise, a talking toaster in surround and a delta-wave meltdown to finish. Nothing here is tasteful, and almost nothing stays in the middle. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume sensible.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Vacuum Sealed
sketches.description: One break, scrambled, hurried and bit-crushed differently every bar, while hats hop between your ears on a seeded coin flip, a ring-modulated bass swings from side to side on tiny delays and keyless bells strike from random places around your head.

sketches.name: Bubble Wrap
sketches.description: Pops at random places all around your head, near and far, while a roll of plastic unspools from a point into a wide wash and a cheerful tune drifts apart between the ears in cents, wider every bar.

sketches.name: Cat in a Box
sketches.description: Headphones on: a soprano who can only say meow sings straight ahead, a gravelly tomcat prowls in a slow circle around your head, the pizzicato sends its lows and highs to different ears and the purr sits diffusely all around your skull.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)

// The diva sings from straight ahead: mi_a_u glides across three vowels in one note
diva: note("<[g4@3 c5] [e5@2 d5 c5] [a5@4] [g5@2 ~@2]>")
  .s("voice").syl("mi_a_u").voicetype("soprano").scoop(-7).jitter(.5)
  .mono(1).vglide(.15).attack(.1).release(.8).distance(1.5).space("hall").gain(.3)

// The tomcat prowls in a slow circle around your head, once every four bars
tom: note("<~ [c3@2 g2@2] ~ [eb3@3 c3]>").s("voice").syl("ma_o").voicetype("tenor").fry(.6)
  .mono(2).vglide(.2).release(.6)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(4)).distance(2.5).posglide(.4).gain(.26)

// Pizzicato with its lows in one ear and its highs in the other, inside a violin body
pizz: note("<[c3 e3 g3 e3] [f3 a3 c4 a3] [d3 f3 a3 f3] [g3 b3 d4 b3]>").s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .earsplit("bands").splitfreq(600).decay(.15).sustain(0).body("violin").bodymix(.3).room(.4).gain(.2)

// The purr: the ears in opposite phase, so it hangs diffusely all around your head
purr: note("c1").slow(4).s("sawtooth").lpf(200).trem(25).tremdepth(.8).iphase(180)
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.12)

sketches.name: Microwave Orbit
sketches.description: The choir that thinks it is a kitchen appliance, now with a turntable: a robot tenor rides once around your head every two bars, the magnetron hum rolls inside your skull and the timer dings hop from ear to ear.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)

// The choir in the centre, ring-modulated and sliding a few hertz either way
choir: note("<[c3,e3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,a2,c3] [g2,b2,d3]>").s("choir")
  .syl("<ah oo ee oh>").ringmod(220).ringmix(.4).fshift(sine.range(-60, 60).slow(8))
  .attack(1).release(2).space("church").gain(.28)

// The turntable: a robot tenor rides once around your head every two bars
robot: note("<c4 ab3 a3 b3>").s("voice").syl("<beep boop bip bop>").voicetype("tenor")
  .spectral("robot").samount(.8).mono(1).vglide(.05)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2)).distance(1.5).posglide(.3).gain(.28)

// The magnetron hum: the phase between the ears turns a quarter, half, one, then two times a second
hum: note("[c2,g2]").s("sawtooth").irate("<.25 .5 1 2>").lpf(300)
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.12)

// The timer: three dings every eight bars, right, left, right
ding: note("<~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [c6 c6 c6 ~]>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(3.5)
  .ild(10).earswap("0 1 0 0").decay(1.2).sustain(0).release(1).room(.4).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Polka Between the Ears
sketches.description: The world's fastest polka, with its accordion split by partials so neither ear hears the whole thing, a tune that hops between your ears, an air-raid siren circling overhead and a rumble that opens from a point into a wash as the sky falls. The phase rotation reaches 2.9 Hz in the last bar, so the player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: Chebyshev's Headache
sketches.description: A sine tune leaps up the harmonic series through a new Chebyshev curve each bar while each ear has its own low-pass sweeping the other way, over a folded bass whose phase rolls inside your head and rectified drums split lows from highs.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// One sine tune through a different Chebyshev curve each bar: the 2nd, 3rd, 5th and 7th harmonic
// Each ear has its own low-pass, sweeping in opposite directions every two bars
lead: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 -1").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").curve("<cheby2 cheby3 cheby5 cheby7>").drive(18)
  .lcutoff(saw.range(500, 6000).slow(2)).rcutoff(isaw.range(500, 6000).slow(2))
  .decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.18)

// A bass folded over on itself through a stack cabinet, its interaural phase turning slowly
bass: note("<a1 a1 f1 g1>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").s("sine")
  .curve("fold").drive(sine.range(4, 22).slow(4)).bias(.2).irate(.5)
  .decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.05).cab("stack").gain(.32)

// Drums through a rectifier, half wet: the lows in one ear, the highs in the other
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*8").curve("rect").drive(8).curvemix(.5)
  .earsplit("bands").splitfreq(900).gain(.45)

sketches.name: Fractal Ears
sketches.description: A melody grown by rewriting rules hops between your ears on the Thue-Morse sequence, the hats are placed evenly around your head by the van der Corput sequence, toms on the primes step around you by the ruler sequence and a Collatz bass has a different brightness in each ear.

sketches.name: Tempo Soup in the Round
sketches.description: One figure at five speeds at once, every note struck from its own place around the room, all crashing into the same note every sixteen bars, while two drummers who disagree stand at either ear and drift apart.

sketches.name: Ghost in the Shrinkwrap
sketches.description: The off-beat hiss carries a hook that exists only between your ears (Huggins pitch), a frozen synth hints at it once every four bars, a pad steps from the centre of your head to all around it and crushed clicks wander around the room. The hidden hook is faint and differs between listeners.

sketches.name: Talking Toaster, Surround
sketches.description: Breakfast in surround: a saw bass that talks in syllables in front of you, a radio muttering behind the bread bin on your right, a kettle on your left whose whistle throbs five times a second, a toaster popping right behind you and a robot announcing from above that the toast is ready. The kettle pulses at 5 Hz, so the player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: Delta Meltdown
sketches.description: The end of the album: one innocent piano phrase melted four ways, four bars each, over a 2 Hz binaural drone in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. The air of the room is wide and diffuse and a clock ticks somewhere behind you.
